notes.title: Last Day of the Next Fest! Come Join the Card Battle!
notes.content:
[h3]《Section Six Requiem》Demo – Steam Next Fest is coming to an end![/h3][p]Thank you all for playing our Demo over the past few days and for leaving such valuable comments and feedback![/p][p]We've read every message carefully—your support and encouragement mean the world to us![/p][p]Today is the last day of the Steam Next Fest, so if you haven’t tried it yet, come check it out while it’s still available![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030630/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]The Demo is free to play and takes about 30 minutes to complete.[/p][p]Join a psychological battle where you must choose between card-based combat and dialogue-based persuasion![/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][h3]Our crowdfunding concept page is now live on Modian![/h3][p]We’ve launched a concept page for 《Section Six Requiem》 on Modian,[/p][p]and we’re planning future crowdfunding for physical goods—such as collectible cards and other merch![/p][p]👉 Simply search [b]“章节六的镇魂曲”[/b] on Modian and click “看好创意” to support us!
Link: [url="https://m.modian.com/idea/9678"]https://m.modian.com/idea/9678[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also working on the official promotional PV, so stay tuned for more exciting updates![/p][p]The full version of 《Section Six Requiem》 is scheduled for release [b]this summer[/b].[/p][p]If you’re interested in the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist (￣▽￣)![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551590/Section_Six_Requiem/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]After playing, feel free to leave a review on the Steam Demo page, fill out our survey, or join our player community to share your thoughts![/p][p]Survey: [url="https://exvles46vdj.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnRePhLbKRKt04gLww8zoylh"]https://exvles46vdj.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnRePhLbKRKt04gLww8zoylh[/url][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/WZmYV5uR7c"]https://discord.com/invite/WZmYV5uR7c[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Baojiang Studio & Eternal Dream Studio[/p][p]June 16, 2025[/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Available! Try it out and Wishlist us!
notes.content:
[h3]Strategic Deckbuilding × Psychological Duels — Will you choose battle, or conversation?[/h3][p][/p][p]Good news, everyone! [/p][p][b]The demo for "Section Six Requiem" is now live and participating in the Steam June Next Fest![/b][/p][h3]You're warmly invited to try it out and leave your feedback![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030630/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]The full version is expected to launch this summer. Stay tuned![/h3][h3]If you enjoy the game, please consider adding it to your Wishlist ! (￣▽￣)[/h3][p]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551590/Section_Six_Requiem/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This is a card battle game with a unique twist—combining deckbuilding strategy with compelling narrative, offering a one-of-a-kind experience![/p][p]The core gameplay revolves around the "Heart Card Protection" system, blending combat and negotiation to challenge your judgment and choices![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900120/cef15f51e3a26412836800f16b4ef743241451d5.png"][/img][/p][p]You play as an agent dispatched by the organization, tasked with pursuing escaped experimental subjects after a containment failure. [/p][p][b]All actions unfold through turn-based card battles![/b][/p][p]Will you dive into their minds, uncovering the stories behind the madness and outwit them with your intellect?[/p][p]Or will you choose ruthless elimination, ending the pursuit in a silent abyss? [/p][p]Persuasion or annihilation—your choices shape the outcome.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900120/3b481d771b8dde9c3222166adb13d62ca100de8d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The demo is free to play, with an estimated playtime of [b]under 30 minutes[/b].[/p][p]Encounter experimental subjects with distinct personalities and mechanics, build your own deck with dozens of stylistically unique cards, and adapt to every changing battle![/p][p][/p][h3]If you enjoy the game, adding it to your wishlist would be a huge help for us![/h3][p]You’re also welcome to leave a review on the Steam Demo page,[/p][p]fill out the feedback form, or join our player group to share your thoughts![/p]
